title: Flow edge cases: missing relationship targets and very large graphs
description:
Two edge cases from the original flow-error-handling pass (ca83f52a, closed as done 2026-10-06) that remain unhandled:

1. Missing relationship targets: a required_for/scheduled_before edge whose target issue does not exist in the store. Decide skip vs warn; give a clear message. Add unit tests and document in help text.
2. Very large graphs (>500 issues): warn or paginate instead of unbounded layout.

Everything else from ca83f52a is merged: cycle and self-cycle rejection, empty-store message, unknown-goal error, isolated-goal error (see flow.rs tests and tests/workflows/flow-goal.trycmd).
